subject: Surge encroachment remediation and temporary tranche assignment - EdgeScale / Aurora
messages:
From: EdgeScale Procurement <procure@edgescale.io>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 23 Jan 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: urgent capacity increase for EdgeScale Q1 activation

Hi David,

We're ramping faster than expected for our Q1 activation and need to request an immediate boost to our dedicated tranche. The current committed profile under DEAL-9842 assumes 8x A100-equivalent GPUs steady-state, but our go-live test produced sustained peaks that will breach that headroom by next week.

Can Redwood allocate an additional 6 GPUs for the next 30 days while we finalize our traffic shaping? This is a revenue-critical activation — failure to increase will force us to delay the go-live by 3+ weeks.

I've attached our amended SLA request and the traffic forecast. Happy to hop on a call.

Attachments: EdgeScale_SLA.pdf (PDF, 120KB), EdgeScale_Q1_Forecast.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Raj Patel
Head of Procurement, EdgeScale
procure@edgescale.io
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Sun, 24 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: urgent capacity increase for EdgeScale Q1 activation

Team — forwarding EdgeScale's ask. TL;DR: EdgeScale is asking for +6 GPUs for 30 days to avoid a hard go-live delay. They reference DEAL-9842 (committed tranche 8 GPUs).

Constraints: we are at ~92% utilization on dedicated pools for the region this week. If we grant +6, someone else will be impacted or we'll have to tap burst/reserved headroom.

Actions I need:
- Karthik: quick run of the roster and a short proposal for triage (preemptions, temporary tranche shift, or burst credit). Please include the latency/SLO risk for any preemption.
- Lauren: commercial options — short-term uplift, credits, or expedited capacity purchase (pricing delta).
- Stephanie: ops — what immediate ops steps are required to reassign capacity and what lead time?

Attachments: Capacity_Roster_Q1_2027.xlsx (internal)

I want a recommendation by EOD Monday. If we can't resolve, I'll escalate to Ben/Sales Leadership for decision.

-David
David Kim
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 10:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: urgent capacity increase for EdgeScale Q1 activation

David / All — ran a quick grid against the Capacity_Roster. Summary:

- Current dedicated assignments (US region) — total committed GPUs: 320. Allocated = 295 (92%).
- Soft headroom (burst pools + transient) = ~12 GPUs, but that is already earmarked for scheduled trials and warm-up for Aurora (PSG) starting 1 Feb.
- Low-risk candidates for temporary preemption: 4 trial accounts that are in a grace test window (trial ids T-1204, T-1211, T-1220, T-1233) — total reclaimable = 10 GPUs but would require notifications and 48-72h migration window.
- Latency/SLO risk: reclaiming the 10 GPUs and assigning to EdgeScale raises tail-latency risk for the larger enterprise customers by ~6-8% under peak; acceptable for 30 days if we provide a SLA amendment and discount.

Recommendation (fast path):
1) Approve preemption of trial tranche T-1204/1211 (reclaim 6 GPUs) immediately and commit to a 72h migration window.
2) Offer EdgeScale the 6 GPUs for 30 days with a 12% rebate on billed consumption for the period as mitigation.
3) Open an operations ticket to ensure Aurora's scheduled warm-up (1 Feb) is not fully blocked — leave 6 GPUs reserved for that window.

If Sales Leadership wants zero preemption, alternate is to allocate from burst pool at a 25% premium; we only have ~6 GPUs available there and it will exhaust burst for the rest of week.

I'll pull a short XLS with the exact tranche IDs and migration steps.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Dedicated Capacity Planning
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: urgent capacity increase for EdgeScale Q1 activation

All — commercial notes on the recommendation:

- DEAL-9842 (EdgeScale) is contracted for $1.2M ARR with a committed tranche; our legal has approved an SLA amendment that permits temporary reassignments with customer consent and a rebate clause.
- Proposed commercial mitigation: 12% rebate for the 30-day tranche (as Karthik suggested) + waiver of early termination fee for any future expansion within 90 days.
- Alternative if we use burst (no preemption): price the 30-day use at a 25% uplift over committed rate and tie to an expedited capacity purchase (30-day option to convert to committed at today's pricing).

I support the preemption + rebate if Leadership signs off — this preserves cost predictability and minimises impact to high-value customers. I've added the HubSpot note to DEAL-9842: https://hubspot.company/DEAL-9842

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Operations Manager
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: EdgeScale Procurement <procure@edgescale.io>, Helio Systems Ops <ops@heliosystems.com>, Aurora Cloud PSG <cloud@aurora.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Request: urgent capacity increase for EdgeScale Q1 activation

Raj / EdgeScale team — thanks for the patience while we evaluated options. Nutshell: we can provision the +6 GPUs you requested for 30 days via temporary reassignment of trial tranches, with two conditions:

1) EdgeScale signs the SLA amendment I attached (EdgeScale_SLA.pdf) approving the temporary tranche assignment and the 12% consumption credit for the period.
2) We require 72 hours notice to cutover; ops will publish a migration window and rollback plan.

Operational notes for all parties:
- Reclaimed tranches: T-1204 and T-1211 (6 GPUs) will be reassigned on Tue 02 Feb 09:00 PST if we receive signed amendment by Mon 01 Feb 17:00 PST.
- We will preserve 6 GPUs reserved for Aurora's warm-up; this action should not block their scheduled onboarding on 1 Feb.
- Post-30 days we will restore the trial tranches; any data-residency or KV-cache implications will be handled by ops (expected <4 hours disruption for trials).

Next steps for EdgeScale: please sign and return the attached SLA amendment and confirm acceptance of the 12% rebate and migration window. If you prefer burst at premium instead of preemption, let us know by EOD tomorrow and we will price it at a 25% uplift.

Attachments: EdgeScale_SLA.pdf, Deal_Prioritization_Matrix.csv

-David
David Kim
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0192
